system.summary: nine-cell grid (AKT · BLV · CMW / DNX · EOY · FPZ / GQ · HR · IS): each letter is the shape of its cell, with no, one or two dots; plus a nomenclator of signs and capitals for names. The key is written in the key book Abt. 171 Nr. C 667, image 55 (upper grid, “1620”)

diacritics.note: one or two dots inside the cell shape select the 2nd or 3rd letter of the cell

system.notes: [3], [ℰ], [ω], [⁘] are nomenclator signs between words (separators or punctuation), kept as they stand. Unresolved nomenclator signs in the readings: [2̲] [A] [Am] [As] [A°] [A·] [A̅] [B] [M] [O.] [O] [Q] [Q·] [V] [W] [∇] [⊙].

prior_solution.where: This repository (no folder, origin/main 123c278cd; catalogue no. 566 notice only); DECODE (not listed); Groen van Prinsterer 2nd series vol. II (1858): no 1620 letter to Johann VII; Briefe und Akten; dbnl/Huygens editions of Willem Lodewijk; Archivportal-D/Arcinsys. A modern pencil slip in the file (fol. 1) gives a partial, partly wrong alphabet of grid H with no decoded word. NOT yet seen: K. Wolf 1937, L. Paul 1966, W. Hahlweg 1973; origin of the slip to be asked of the HHStAW.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the target from the catalogue and set the rules (frozen key before validation, held-out checks, prior-work search the day of publication); AI agents transcribed, solved, checked and wrote up. Doubtful signs were settled by targeted visual review where stated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Key book C 667 image 55 found (pointed to by the cover of S 995); upper grid H applies to the 1620 letters.
Grid H frozen, one measurement on 11 cipher words with contemporary glosses: 0.860 vs grid B 0.185 and 20 permuted grids max 0.442.
Shapes of fols. 20r-21v, 41r-41v, 44r-44v and 53r transcribed sign by sign on 300 dpi scans, each frozen by SHA-256 before decoding.
Pre-registered visual re-reading of 22 doubtful shapes of letter 3 (answers by Brice Dudout, applied mechanically): 21 confirmed, 1 became unresolved.
Decoded with grid H unchanged and read by Daniel's rule: 96.4% certain + probable, 98.2% with restored (count by script on the published text).

outcome.method_basis: Period key book HHStAW Abt. 171 Nr. C 667 image 55 (grid H), validated on contemporary glosses of the same file; shapes transcribed and frozen before decoding.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Daniel's rule, script count on the *_reading.md files: 1388 cipher words, 1184 certain, 154 probable, 25 restored, 25 unresolved; certain + probable = 1338/1388.

validation.notes: Contributor's held-out test (not docs/_validate.py): grid H frozen (SHA-256); one measurement on 11 cipher words carrying contemporary glosses (fols. 25, 29): mean character agreement 0.860 vs 0.185 for the other grid of the page and at best 0.442 (mean 0.163) for 20 permuted grids. Thresholds: >= 0.85 and >= 0.30 above the best control. Only 20 controls; 4 words had been seen with their gloss before.

credits.note: key identified in C 667 img 55 and validated; letters 1, 3, 5 and postscript transcribed and read (96.4% certain + probable)
Catalogue entry no. 566 (Archivportal-D sweep) and the reading rule.

gaps.item: nomenclator capitals and symbols ([A], [B], [Q], [M], [O], [⊙], [∇], [V], [W] ...); list of capitals in C 667 images 20-54 not seen
ciphered dates ("Datum [D] den [W]/[W] [S]. [y x° w]"): number signs unresolved
postscript fol. 53r line 16 runs to the edge of the leaf; continuation not seen

texts.label: Letter 1, fols. 20r-21v, Willem Lodewijk to Johann VII, spring 1620
texts.summary: Advice to keep the general command of the defence ("beim commendo maintenirt"); if age weighs, to withdraw as an "emeritus miles"; a plan for the command of the relief forces is "nicht practicabel vnd gantz immature".

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 4 Nov 2026 (German, 1620 spelling): Advice to keep the general command of the defence ("beim commendo maintenirt"); if age weighs, to withdraw as an "emeritus miles"; a plan for the command of the relief forces is "nicht practicabel vnd gantz immature". 722 cipher words, 636 certain, 72 probable, 8 restored, 6 unresolved = 98.1% (99.2% with restored); nomenclator signs left in brackets. Grade A: coherent sentences, scattered holes.

texts.label: Letter 3, fols. 41r-41v, Willem Lodewijk to Johann VII, spring 1620
texts.summary: Answer to Johann's defence plan for the Lower [Q]: militia plus a regular corps, muster by Circles, no invasion towards the Weser this year, provisions and artillery train.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences 4 Nov 2026 (German, 1620 spelling): Answer to Johann's defence plan for the Lower [Q]: militia plus a regular corps, muster by Circles, no invasion towards the Weser this year, provisions and artillery train. 430 cipher words, 348 certain, 50 probable, 16 restored, 16 unresolved = 92.6% (96.3% with restored); nomenclator signs left in brackets. Grade B: 16 unresolved words grouped in fol. 41v lines 21-25, where two sentences have holes.

texts.label: Letter 5, fols. 44r-44v (cipher part), Willem Lodewijk to Johann VII, spring 1620
texts.summary: Hopes Johann will continue in his charge; dangerous to write such matters "ohne chifer"; [V] Portuguese coming into the [Q].
